description: Individual location entries for five Whispering Web relay hubs.

entries.title: The Skyward Spire
entries.summary: A crystal-crowned mountain relay withstands high winds, storms, avalanches, bandit seizures, and elemental intrusion.
body: Enchanted stone and crystal latticework rises from a remote peak. Rune-operated elevator platforms connect narrow levels beneath the pulsing apex crystal.
Common crises include ransom-taking occupiers, resident air elementals, structural storm damage, and hazardous maintenance ascents.

sections.heading: Legacy Environmental Checks
body: The source specifies checks against high winds and rune puzzles. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Verdant Nexus
entries.summary: A living forest relay blends crystal infrastructure with roots, vines, druids, fey, and vulnerable ecology.
body: The camouflaged node hums within ancient woodland while roots reshape passages around intruders. Druids may oppose its disruption of natural balance, fey can scramble communications, and blight may corrupt both structure and forest.
Fire and necrotic magic risk provoking the surrounding living architecture.

entries.title: Azure Watchtower
entries.summary: A fortified coastal relay and tide-gated dock face pirates, sea monsters, squalls, cliffs, and underwater recovery missions.
body: Crystalline conduits run through a tower carved into a sea cliff and hardened against salt and storms. Its hidden maintenance dock opens only at high tide.
Raiders seek its crystals, great marine creatures attack its magical signature, and fallen components can force expeditions into flooded caverns.

sections.heading: Legacy Environmental Checks
body: The source gives footing saves during squalls. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Emberforge Bastion
entries.summary: A geothermal volcanic relay channels magma and steam through metal walkways and arcane machinery.
body: Resonance crystals draw power from a dormant volcano. Magma elementals, rival sabotage, explosive runes, overloaded conduits, and volcanic awakening can turn maintenance into catastrophe.
Power surges and hazardous channels can harm occupants while temporarily amplifying magic.

sections.heading: Legacy Hazard Effects
body: Damage and spell-empowerment effects require conversion.

entries.title: Shadowspire Crypt
entries.summary: A subterranean relay occupies an ancient warded crypt threatened by invaders, undead, magical darkness, and crystal theft.
body: Glowing runes mark corridors extending from the central communication node. Failing necromantic wards raise the dead, subterranean forces contest the site, and experimental factions covet its resonance crystal.
Magical darkness and guardian-summoning glyphs make navigation dangerous even when the hub is functioning.
